verdict.rationale: Codex CLI runs locally as a client, but it requires signing into a ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key to access the underlying model (codex-gh-3, codex-gh-4); there is no evidence the core model/service can be self-hosted, and a community comment explicitly wishes the app were open source (codex-comm-9), implying it isn't fully self-hostable.
